description: This file implements WebSocket endpoints using FastAPI for real-time delivery updates and notifications, managing WebSocket connections, broadcasting messages, and handling heartbeats for keep-alive functionality.

methods.name: None _safe_send_json(ws: WebSocket, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Safely send a JSON payload to a WebSocket, ignoring errors if not connected.

methods.name: None _register_delivery_ws(delivery_id: int, ws: WebSocket)
methods.description: Register a WebSocket connection under a delivery room.

methods.name: None _register_user_ws(user_id: int, ws: WebSocket)
methods.description: Register a WebSocket connection under a user's notification channel.

methods.name: None _unregister_ws(ws: WebSocket)
methods.description: Unregister a WebSocket connection from internal registries.

methods.name: None _broadcast_to_delivery(delivery_id: int, event: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Broadcast an event to all WebSocket connections in a delivery room.

methods.name: None _broadcast_to_user(user_id: int, event: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Broadcast an event to all WebSocket connections in a user's notification channel.

methods.name: None _heartbeat(ws: WebSocket)
methods.description: Periodically send ping messages to keep WebSocket connection alive.

methods.name: None _authorize_delivery_access(delivery_id: int, current_user: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Verify if the current user is authorized to subscribe to a delivery room.

methods.name: ws_deliveries( websocket: WebSocket, delivery_id: int, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: WebSocket endpoint for real-time delivery updates, managing connections and messaging.

methods.name: ws_notifications( websocket: WebSocket, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: WebSocket endpoint for real-time user notifications, managing connections and messaging.

methods.name: None emit_delivery_location_update(delivery_id: int, location_payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Broadcast a delivery location update to the relevant delivery room.

methods.name: None emit_delivery_status_update(delivery_id: int, status_payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Broadcast a delivery status update to the relevant delivery room.

methods.name: None emit_user_notification(user_id: int, notification_payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Broadcast a notification to a specific user's notification channel.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_ws_usage_help()
methods.description: Return documentation for WebSocket API endpoints for inclusion in OpenAPI documentation.
